name: agentbridge
description: Local CLI task bridge with independent Hub and Edge processes

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
scripts.acceptance: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/core.test.ts tests/hub-fault.test.ts && node --import tsx scripts/acceptance.ts
scripts.acceptance:opencode: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/opencode-acceptance.ts
scripts.acceptance:cli: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/i03a-acceptance.ts
scripts.acceptance:continuous: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/i03b-acceptance.ts
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm run pack:win --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
